friends.doc: The friends list and its Inbox (Docs/features/15-social.md §2.1, §2.3).

max.doc: How many friends a player may have.

maxSent.doc: How many friend requests a player may have waiting for an answer at once.

requestRows.doc: Rows the requests list fills with suggestions, counting the requests already in it.

requestHours.doc: Hours a friend request waits for an answer before it expires.

messageDays.doc: Days an Inbox message is kept.

trade.doc: Trading with friends on the wish board (Docs/features/15-social.md §2.4). A piece and a keystone always trade one at a time.

materialLot.doc: How much of a precious material one lot is.

wishes.doc: How many wishes a player may have pinned at once.

wishHours.doc: Hours a wish stands before its stake comes back.

fillsPerDay.doc: How many friends' wishes a player may fill in any 24 hours.

friendHelp.doc: Daily help between friends (Docs/features/15-social.md §3). A friend is helped once in any 24 hours.

perDay.doc: How many friends a player may help in any 24 hours.

helperManaMinutes.doc: What a help pays the helper: this many minutes of their own Mana regeneration, at least 1 Mana.

giftItem.doc: The item a helped friend finds in their Bag.
